captions.LI: Many patients receiving medical treatment for obesity benefit from behavioral support alongside their care. The Bariatric Counseling Center is a behavioral health facility focused exclusively on the behavioral treatment of obesity. The staff is comprised of a clinical psychologist, licensed professional counselors, registered dietitians, movement therapists, and a registered nurse, as well as a professional chef. The program can be standalone behavioral treatment for obesity, or in addition to bariatric surgery or weight loss medication that patients receive from their medical providers. Our team coordinates care with referring medical providers and, at patient discharge, we give referring providers a detailed summary of the patient's behavioral progress during the time in our intensive outpatient program, including changes in assessment scores measuring nutrition quality of life, disordered eating, anxiety, and depression, among other metrics. Progress notes as requested. We accept most health insurances. Our Director of Admissions is Leloni Gonzales: lgonzales@bccsanantonio.com and 210-634-2200. San Antonio and virtual across Texas. #BehavioralHealth
